data.one_liner: An SVG avatar generator and customizer library for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Customizer widget, avatar display widget, and utility functions to render, customize, save, and load SVG avatars. Avatars can be styled using a variety of properties such as hair, facial hair, outfits, and accessories.
use_when: You need user profile avatars with built-in customization UIs.
You want vector-based SVG avatars derived from getavataaars.com assets.
avoid_when: You need to render raster images like PNG or JPEG profile pictures from a gallery.
You are targeting web and cannot use the canvaskit renderer.
strengths: Extensive customizable SVG styles and components.
Includes ready-to-use widgets like customizers, randomizers, and save/reset buttons.
Supports persistent local storage of user avatar options.
weaknesses: Requires the canvaskit renderer on web to render SVGs properly.
AvatarMakerAvatar only renders the local user's saved avatar by default.
data.setup_notes: Wrap your app or screen with AvatarMakerProvider and add the provided widgets.
